author: Eddie Makuch
description:
One of the first cool things that people discovered in Grand Theft Auto 6 is that if you swim out into the ocean too far, you'll find a dog riding a jetski who coaxes you back to shore.

As it turns out, the dog looks to be based on a real-life dog named Loosy who does neat stunts in Florida. In real life, Loosy is a golden retriever whose owner, Eddie Inch, gained viral fame when he rode a jet-propelled hoverboard in Fort Lauderdale as he towed a goggle-wearing Loosy behind him on a jetski.

It seems Rockstar took inspiration from this with GTA 6's own jetski-riding dog. However, GTA 6's dog is a different breed, but it still has goggles like Loosy.
title: GTA 6 Dog Who Saves You Is Seemingly Based On A Very Cool Real-Life Dog

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever is approaching itemization and "best-in-slot" (BiS) gear differently, with developer Blizzard instead wanting players to have more boss- or biome-specific choices.

In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, Blizzard dove deep on the MMORPG's itemization changes, how it approached designing Forever's new items, class changes, and more.

On the subject of raid gear and chase items, Forever senior game designer Aidan Moon said something that could be seen as controversial in certain circles of the game's community.

"I essentially want to get rid of BiS," Moon said. "I think that BiS is not a good thing for a video game that's supposed to be about [the] role-playing aspects of it."
title: WoW: Forever Wants To Get Rid Of The Idea Of “BiS” Gear

author: Chris Pereira
description:
Conventional wisdom might suggest that releasing in the proximity of Grand Theft Auto 6 is not a wise idea. GTA 6 is sucking up all the oxygen in the room, leaving little time or attention for anything else. Other developers might not care, because GTA 6's audience is not their target. A retro-style platformer would seem to fall in the latter camp, though publisher Devolver Digital made it clear its goal all along was specifically to release a game on the same day as GTA 6. That publicity stunt certainly helped to attract some level of attention for the game that it would not have otherwise earned, and as it happens, the game itself is worth a look.

Given the recent Steam review backlog issues that have forced a number of games to miss their release dates, I wondered if Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed might f
title: I Spent GTA 6’s Launch Playing A $5 Game That Also Came Out Today, And I Have No Regrets

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Ubisoft has enacted another round of mass layoffs, affecting 166 additional jobs as the French gaming giant continues its cost-cutting program.

The job cuts are happening at two of Ubisoft's biggest development hubs in Montreal and Quebec. A spokesperson for Ubisoft said the job cuts are coming to meet changing production needs, and IGN reported that the layoffs came from teams working on projects that have been "canceled or refocused."

"We deeply value the contributions of these teams and recognise the impact this may have on our colleagues. We are committed to supporting them through this process with care and respect," the spokesperson said. "Those affected are being provided with severance, extended health
title: More Mass Layoffs At Ubisoft Underway, Affecting Two Of Its Biggest Studios

author: Joey Carr
description:
Strip Clubs have become a cornerstone feature of the Grand Theft Auto franchise, and, of course, there are some to visit in GTA 6. Leonida is a vast land of personalities, many of whom work in and around strip clubs, so you can head into a few different establishments during your playthrough.

What you do in the strip club is up to you, as long as you have some cash in your pockets, but you'll need to find the clubs before you think about what goes on inside those walls. Below, you can see every strip club currently in GTA 6, where they're located, and what you can do once you're there.

author: Joey Carr
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has no shortage of challenges that you can complete all over the map, but none of them get your adrenaline pumping like a base jump. Returning from GTA 5, base jump challenges are spread out across Leonida, and they require you to parachute through checkpoints to eventually reach a specific spot on the ground safely.

While this sounds simple enough, there's some strategy involved with completing the base jumps in GTA 6. If that wasn't enough, you'll also have to visit over two dozen locations in Leonida if you want to complete every single base jump challenge. Below, you can see the best way to complete a base jump and where to find every challenge location in GTA 6.

Best way to complete a Base Jump Challenge in GTA 6

description:
One of the most memorable aspects of the last GTA game is its multiple endings, which force you to choose between friendship and loyalty or self-preservation. This was such a celebrated feature in that game, but Rockstar Games kept quiet about whether GTA 6 would follow suit with multiple endings of its own.

Fortunately, now that it's out for the entire world to play, we finally have an answer as to whether GTA 6 has multiple endings of its own. Below, you can read what we've learned firsthand.

Please note that this guide avoids specific story details as much as possible, but if you consider a yes-or-no answer and descriptions of late-game systems spoilers, then turn around and go back to our

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and people are discovering all manner of little details in the game that speak to the developer's commitment to realism. One such detail is the game's weightlifting and general fitness systems, and they seem to be pretty great, so much so that if you're thinking about getting into weight lifting, GTA 6's lessons are a good place to start. 

For starters, Jason has a home gym, and that's just smart on his part. Not having to leave your house and head to a gym is a godsend for anyone short on time or for those who simply enjoy the solitude of slinging weight around alone. For Jason, it's even better--he lives on the water, and it looks pretty damn s
title: Want To Start Lifting Effectively? GTA 6 Is A Good Teacher

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI is finally out for consoles, and it's every bit the visual showcase of the generation that it was promising to be since its reveal. You'll struggle to find a better-looking game on the current generation of hardware, but one concession Rockstar had to make to achieve that was limiting its frame rate--a limitation some players are going to absurd lengths to overcome.

Irrespective of what platform you play on, Grand Theft Auto VI is limited to 30fps. Doubling that to the more desirable 60fps is something current console hardware just isn't capable of with this level of visual fidelity and simulation, which means you'll have to rely on other methods of frame generation to get there. title: You Can Play Grand Theft Auto 6 At 60fps Using This Absurdly Complicated Method

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever's player vs. player systems will work much differently than in previous versions of old-school WoW, developer Blizzard has revealed.

While Forever is now out in the wild and breaking records from the MMORPG, how its PvP rank system would work remained a mystery, as the game's first PvP season isn't yet live. Now, Blizzard has shared more information about how players will earn PvP ranks and honor, with the main takeaway being that players won't have to commit to months of grinding or competing with players on their own faction for top ranks.

Honor, a currency earned from killing enemy players and completing battlegrounds and PvP activities, will now exclusively be used to purchase PvP gear and doesn't impact progress towards ranks. Instead, players will rank points by completing daily and week
title: How WoW: Forever Is Overhauling Classic WoW’s Infamous PvP Honor Grind

description:
The state of Leonida is vast, and you’re going to spend countless hours trying to go from one place to another. Thankfully, Grand Theft Auto 6 does have a few fast travel methods. description:
As more and more parts are required to send through the Space Elevator stages, my humble factory expands. What was once a simple system, requiring nothing but biofuel and a small amount of automation, is now a tower of twisting conveyors that would look unintelligible to anyone who stepped foot into my save. To me, it makes sense. Satisfactory is the gamification of organized chaos, and this survival-automation blend is, well, satisfying—so why not buy it at its lowest price?

The goal is simple: On an alien planet, working for FICSIT Inc., you need to gather increasingly difficult resources to send up to your corporate overlords, with each stage of the Space Elevator's requirements becoming more challenging and lengthy as time goes on. Satisfactory, however, avoids overwhelming you, and there's a natural progression from a sma

description:
It's Grand Theft Auto VI day around the world--the game is really good, as it turns out. While players are out exploring the massive in-game map or checking their in-game phones as much as they check their real-life ones, Rockstar has celebrated the occasion by releasing the full cast list for its new crime epic.

Nestled among celebrity names like Bad Bunny, "Weird Al" Yankovic, Brigitte Nielsen, Stephen Root, and Bobby Moynihan is a name that will surprise many longtime Rockstar fans. It's also, potentially, a GTA VI spoiler, so we're going to put it below a selfie of co-protagonist Jason Duval.

author: Chris Pereira
description:
Among the many fine details you'll encounter in Grand Theft Auto VI are various forms of reading material. At first, you might assume this is just Rockstar showing off by offering things like books and magazines that can be opened up, rather than just being an object you can't interact with. Although many of the things you can read are simply there to flesh out the world, there are rewards for looking through some of them, so you should be sure to fully flip through each one you come across.

The earliest instance of this that we've found is when you first arrive at Jason's home and are allowed to freely roam around it. Head downstairs and through the door to the small shed on the ground level, and you'll find a fishing magazine, Off The Hook. The bottom of the cover teases it contains "top spots for a decent catch" in Leonida, and it turns out that's not just a meaningless detail. Flip a few pages in, and when you reac
title: Make Sure To Read Everything In GTA 6

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and along with that, the actors playing the main characters Jason (Dylan Rourke) and Lucia (Manni L. Perez) have released a heartfelt joint statement.

"Years witnessing the hardest working and most skilled artisans game making has to offer. We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower," they said. "So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See y’all in Leonida."
title: GTA 6’s Stars Release A Very Nice Statement As Game Goes Live

author: Steve Watts
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is now available worldwide, which means millions of people are simultaneously discovering its characters, its open-world sandbox, and its story. And now that it's out in the wild, we're all discovering major story elements, including one that Rockstar impressively hid from players so we could see it for ourselves. That decision was the right one, because it made the moment impactful.

Grand Theft Auto 6 Prologue Spoilers Follow

description:
Walt Disney World is synonymous with Florida, but the iconic theme park doesn't show up in Rockstar's GTA 6, which takes place in a fictional Florida called Leonida. Many are wondering why, especially when GTA: Vice City had its own parody of the theme park--Fun World--many years ago.

Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson said the decision to came down to resources and story reasons. “A theme park would represent a lot of work that we didn’t have, and we didn’t have a strong narrative reason to send them there,” he told

description:
The GTA 6 launch looks set to break several records, as the digital-only game appears on track to be a major critical and commercial hit. Right on cue, GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen has criticized publishers that forgo a traditional physical release as a business strategy that hurts consumers and GameStop's bottom line, without explicitly mentioning GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive.

title: GTA 6’s Digital Release Has GameStop CEO Defending Physical Games, For Obvious Reasons

Players who stick around after fixing the sink to explore Mandy's place found other clues that point to Mandy being a killer.

description:
In just a few short hours, the years-long wait for Grand Theft Auto 6 will finally be over. And maybe you should see exactly what you're in for, with the GameSpot video team livestream. Starting at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET, the crew will kick off their trip to Vice City from the very beginning, and you can expect around four hours of digital tourism and GTA chaos during this session.

How to unlock first-person shooting in GTA 6

title: Does GTA 6 Have A First-Person Mode?

description:
Grand Theft Auto games have regularly kept up with the times, and in GTA 6, you once again have a smartphone that you can use to interact with the world around you. From getting new missions to goofing off by wasting some in-game time on social media, the smartphone in GTA 6 is a pretty handy tool for rising up the social--and criminal--ranks of Leonida. It comes equipped with several apps, and while not every one of them is essential, you'll want to keep an eye open for certain notifications. Here's a closer look at what each app does.

How to use your smartphone

As a quick reminder, you can whip out your smartphone by using the Up key on the D-pad. From there, you can navigate through the apps menu using the directional keys.
